cards.name: Ancient One's Help
cards.description:
Innate.
Retain.
Deal 40 (50) damage to ALL enemies.
Stun ALL enemies.
Increase Ancient Debt by 1.
Gets temporarily removed during Boss Fights.

relics.name: Ancient Necronomicon
relics.description: Upon pickup, add Ancient One's Help to your Deck. You may Sacrifice at Rest Sites.
relics.flavorText: You can hear whispers coming from the book...

relics.name: Ancient One's Bookmark
relics.description: The first Attack or Skill you play each turn returns to your Hand.
relics.flavorText: Mark your favourite pages with this handy bookmark!

relics.name: Colorful Sketchbook
relics.description: Combat rewards contain an additional card reward with cards from other characters.
relics.flavorText: With a sketchbook and the tools to paint, the only limitation is your imagination.

relics.name: Cosmic Egg
relics.description: You may feed card rewards to the Cosmic Egg. Every 3 feeds, the next combat reward contains an additional Rare card reward.
relics.flavorText: A mysterious egg from far beyond Preon. Perhaps nurturing it will bring about great boons...

relics.name: Ina's Prophecy
relics.description: Upon pickup, Enchant a card in your Deck with Omen.
relics.flavorText: Her prophecy remains as a Forethought, forever in your mind now.

relics.name: Maddening Whispers
relics.description: Gain [E] at the start of each turn. At the start of your turn, a random card in your hand becomes Possessed until end of turn.
relics.flavorText: The voices won't go away, no matter how much you try. It's best to embrace the madness they bring.

relics.name: Ritual Conduit
relics.description: Whenever you spend [E] during your turn, gain that much Strength this turn.
relics.flavorText: As energy flows through this conduit, the wearer seems to experience a boost in power.

relics.name: Takodachi
relics.description: Doubles Debuffs applied by a card, then goes to sleep for 2 turns.

relics.name: The Forbidden Wah
relics.description: The 4th Attack you play each turn deals triple damage. You cannot play more than 4 Attacks each turn.

relics.name: Writhing Tentacles
relics.description: Gain [E] at the start of each turn. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Constrict.
relics.flavorText: An adventurer's worst nightmare. Or wildest dream, depending on the adventurer.

enchantments.name: Omen
enchantments.description: Values on this card are doubled, but it's always shuffled into the bottom of the Draw Pile, including at the start of combat.

keywords.name: Awakening
keywords.description: The first time this creature's HP reaches 50% or below, it becomes Stunned.

keywords.name: Maddening Whispers
keywords.description: Possessed cards must be played before any other cards can be played.

keywords.name: Ritual Conduit
keywords.description: Gain Strength until the end of this turn.

keywords.name: Constrict
keywords.description: At the end of your turn, take damage.

afflictions.name: Possessed
afflictions.description: Possessed cards must be played before any other cards can be played. Clears at the end of turn.

mods.name: Ninomae Ina'nis Ancient
mods.description:
Adds Ninomae Ina'Nis from Hololive EN as an Ancient in Act 2.

Ancient Image not mine, by PeaceableColt on Pixiv.
